{{Quote|Well, well, if it isn't the Rebel Alliance! Seeing as how you're all about helping people, how about lending me a hand? I've got some unwanted Imperial attention...|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="EaW" />}}
The '''Raid above Corellia''' was a minor skirmish during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was rescued by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] over [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The captured pirate has divulged information he's gathered on this superweapon project. We know where Tarkin was conducting research, but we risk a frontal assault on a fortified Imperial station.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="EaW" />}}
After having [[Battle at Atzerri|captured]] a pirate informer over [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had learnt that [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] was personally overseeing the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death Star/Legends|superweapon project]] from a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] orbiting [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. But before attacking the station, the Rebels needed to find a way to disable the defenses of the station.

After hearing of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] success at [[Prison Break on Kashyyyk|rescuing]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and a number of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] earlier on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] strived to contact him to help the Rebellion's investigations. They eventually found him caught in a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] tractor beam over [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==The raid==
{{Quote|We will consider it payment for future services rendered.''"<br />"''Payment? Well, I&hellip; okay, okay! Fine! Deal! Just get us out of here!|Mon Mothma and Han Solo|<ref name="EaW" />}}
[[File:Rescue_the_Millennium_Falcon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] attacking the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]]]

The rebels sent a small fleet in the system to rescue him. While the Rebel fleet attacked the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] moved in to disable the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] of the command Star Destroyer. They eventually managed to destroy it before it could reach the [[Cardan-class space station|''Cardan''-class space station]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] escaped and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspaced]] out of the system.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We have a mission for you, Captain Solo. Something that I feel is perfectly suited for someone with your particular... skills. We have an errand for you to run to Vergesso.|Mon Mothma to Han Solo|<ref name="EaW" />}}
Mon Mothma later personally recruited [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], despite Solo's reluctance, to assist the Rebels in the [[Raid over Corulag|raid]] on the Imperial research facility over Corulag. Solo was hired to [[Scanning in the Vergesso Asteroids|plant]] a tracking device and [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|EMP]] in one of the cargo containers bound for the research station.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was the seventh mission of the Rebel campaign in the [[2006]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''.
